notes.title: Demo Available Now !
notes.content: [p]The demo is finally live! Feel free to playtest it. [/p][p]We are only a team of 2 developers: Vaeh on art and exe_kO handling the technical stuff, so even the smallest bit of feedback from you is especially valuable (but please be nice we're doing our best).
